name: Hodge conjecture for Fermat fourfolds of odd degree (Theorem F)
target: Every rational Hodge class on the Fermat fourfold of odd degree m is algebraic
result: Proved (new from degree 201 on); the Hodge conjecture in general stays open.

notes.formal: Lean + Mathlib proves the classification of Hodge characters for m prime to 6 and the exceptional cases, not the general induction step; the geometric inputs are published theorems
notes.human: not yet refereed (Mathematische Annalen package ready)
